svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — landing
svg.desc: Concept 02 Orienteering Course: landing page first viewport.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner turns your warehouse’s own exports into a
re-slotting plan you can check, adjust, print and walk.
Import the Locations, Inventory and Transactions files. Mark your best
locations. The tool recommends moves in rounds, each with its rule and
the picks behind it. You apply, pick another location or keep in place.
Runs on the synthetic demo data. The import is never changed.
Rules, not guesses: every number can be traced to your transactions.
Per aisle: parts in and out,
a tick box on every line
Every move names its rule and the numbers behind it
